card.name: Increased before risk after fold
card.fires_on: The word "increased" right after a multiplier such as "10-fold" or "threefold", just before the word "risk". It also fires on a few other words that come right before "risk" or "courage".

modes.label: Fold-increase before risk
modes.description: "Increased" follows a fold or times multiplier and leads into "risk" of a bleed or cardiovascular event.
